long_biography.plain_text:
Before establishing his own port venture, Cătălin Trandafir worked at Chimpex, where he learned the workings of Constanța's docks. He joined forces with Mihai Feleșcu in 1993. Ship agency services came first; the business subsequently developed grain storage and cargo-handling facilities. Trandafir distinguished moving grain for clients from buying or selling the commodity. Nidera's acquisition of their terminal operation ended the partners' ownership of that business.

Agrilend, a lender serving farmers, was among Trandafir's subsequent ventures. He also took interests in agricultural trading and other enterprises around Constanța. At Prodveg Solaris, a trading company, he has served as an administrator.
